translation: The Plain Questions, Bone Hollows Discourse says: When the Governing Vessel (Dumai) gives rise to disease, [qi] rushes upward from the lower abdomen to the heart causing pain, and one cannot pass urine or stool; this is Chong hernia (chongshan). In women it is infertility, strangury (long), hemorrhoids, enuresis, and dry throat (yi). Treatment is on the bone above (this refers to the region of the pubic hair on the transverse bone of the waist, the Qugu point); in severe cases, at the ying below the navel (one cun below the navel, the Yinjiao point). Wang Qixuan said: These are diseases of the Ren and Chong vessels; I do not know why they are attributed to the Governing Vessel.
